text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having finished the Tenno Sho (Spring), 
Seiun Sky could feel that Special Week had 
grown even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The sheer threat of a talented individual 
stacking effort upon effort. How on earth 
can one counter that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to confirm something for herself, 
Seiun Sky conveys her resolve to the 
Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She decided to set her sights on the 
Takarazuka Kinen, where Special Week and 
Grass Wonder would likely compete as well.
